name: Double Frames Flower Shadow Box
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:  

Each product includes two connected wooden frames with a durable black metal hinge. MDF backboards for support and high-clarity acrylic/glass front panel. The thickness of each frame is 3 cm ~ 1.18 inches. It features a sturdy black metal hinge that securely connects the two frames, allowing smooth folding and display.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions: 

 - Available in three sizes to fit your needs. Each consists of two connected frames (left and right), with total thickness when closed is 6 cm (3 cm per frame).

S – 12.7 x 17.8 x 3 cm * 2

M– 15.2 x 20.3 x 3 cm * 2

L – 20.3 x 25.4 x 3 cm * 2

 - Flower Colors and Layout Options: Heart Shaped Background and Full Flowers Filled Background 

 

  • Left Frame:

 - Can be filled with rectangular full flowers or heart-shaped flower arrangements and customize UV-printed design on glass panel. 

 - Choose from 8 beautiful flower colors: Red, Purple, Light Blue, Dark Blue, Light Pink, Violet Pink, Peach Pink, Light Orange.

  • Right Frame:  Personalized UV-printed design on glass front panel.

 

  • Printing Technology: 

Printed using advanced UV printing technology, ensuring high-resolution images with vibrant and crisp colors. Text and illustrations appear sharp and long-lasting.

 

  • Functionality & Usage: 

This shadow box can be customized with a meaningful calendar date, personal message, and artwork or illustration. It serves as a touching keepsake for displaying memories and heartfelt moments. Perfect for desktops, shelves, mantels, or office tables, etc.

 

  • Perfect Gift for All Occasions: 

An ideal gift for mothers, grandparents, partners, friends, or loved ones. Perfect for Mother’s Day, anniversaries, birthdays, Valentine’s Day, or any other meaningful occasion.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 8-15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Double Flowers Frame Box

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made in China

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.2 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 

 

  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

 

  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.

 

  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.

 

  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.

 

  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.

 

  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.

 

  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

 

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.

 

  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
